title: Dancing With the Wind - Visual Bible
style_prefix: Photorealistic live-action cinematic film still, shot on ARRI Alexa 65 with vintage anamorphic lenses, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, natural skin texture, surreal magical-realism tone, 16:9, 24fps motion cadence.
style_suffix: No text, no subtitles, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no dialogue, no lip movement.
negative_prompt: text, subtitles, captions, watermark, logo, title card, cartoon, anime, illustration, CGI look, video game render, extra limbs, deformed hands, distorted face, duplicate person, multiple protagonists, flickering, morphing identity, lip sync, talking

camera_rules.lens: anamorphic 40mm-75mm equivalents, oval bokeh, gentle horizontal flare
camera_rules.movement: slow deliberate camera moves only: dolly-in, slow push, slow orbit, locked-off. No whip pans, no handheld shake.
camera_rules.protagonist_framing: keep the protagonist's face clearly visible and consistently lit in every shot; avoid extreme wide shots where the face is unreadable, except S05/S06 (staircase scale) and S15 (final walk away).

act1_street_and_sacrifice.palette: cold desaturated teal and slate blue with sodium-orange streetlight accents; memories glow warm amber before turning metallic gold
act1_street_and_sacrifice.lighting: night, wet surfaces, practical streetlights, soft low-key

act2_ascent.palette: monochrome gold and black; endless golden staircase in a black void with slow-moving dark clouds, shafts of pale gold light from above
act2_ascent.lighting: single strong top light, deep shadows

act3_palace.palette: saturated royal gold, warm ivory, champagne highlights, candlelight
act3_palace.lighting: thousands of candles and chandeliers, warm high-key glamour

act4_uncanny_collapse.palette: the gold drains toward sickly brass and grey; cracks reveal warm amber memory light inside the walls
act4_uncanny_collapse.lighting: chandeliers flicker, color temperature drifts colder, hard shadows appear

act5_return.palette: near-black, desaturated blue-grey, a single distant cold streetlight
act5_return.lighting: almost no light; the man is a silhouette with faint rim light

locations.L1_seoul_alley: a narrow Seoul back alley at night (Euljiro style): wet black asphalt reflecting a single orange sodium streetlight, old brick walls, tangled power lines overhead, shuttered shop fronts, dead leaves and loose paper swirling in a strong wind
locations.L1b_seoul_alley_ruined: the same narrow Seoul back alley decades later: streetlight dead, shop fronts demolished to rubble, brick walls collapsed, power lines hanging loose, no people, thick darkness, wind still blowing dust
locations.L2_kitchen: a small humble Korean apartment kitchen at night, warm tungsten light, a wooden table with rice bowls and side dishes, a window with wind rattling it
locations.L3_pojangmacha: an orange-tented pojangmacha street stall at night with steam, plastic stools and strings of bare bulbs swaying in the wind
locations.L4_mirror_room: a bare rented room with a cracked full-length mirror on a wall, a bare bulb, wind pushing a thin curtain
locations.L5_golden_staircase: an impossibly long golden staircase rising through a black void, each step inlaid with gilded fragments of photographs, letters and music-box parts, dark clouds drifting past, pale gold light from far above
locations.L6_golden_palace: a vast golden palace ballroom blending European baroque and Korean royal palace motifs: gilded dancheong patterns on massive columns, a mirrored floor, hundreds of candles, towering chandeliers; the walls are entirely made of gilded family photographs, letters and music-box parts fused into ornament
locations.L7_void: an endless black void with faint drifting gold dust, no floor visible, the man lit only by a soft dying top light

continuity_checks.mole: the small mole below the outer corner of the left eye must be present in every face-visible shot
continuity_checks.coat: charcoal overcoat present in all 15 shots
continuity_checks.aging_order: A_20s -> B_30s -> C_40s -> D_50s -> E_70s, never reversed
continuity_checks.wind: visible wind (hair, coat hem, leaves, curtains, gown train) in every shot; it is the film's motif
continuity_checks.no_text: any readable text in a frame is a reject
